summary: matrix-gen.sh is exemplary (set -euo pipefail, proper quoting, clear error handling). Workflow follows standards (pinned actions, lean permissions, correct fromJSON patterns). However, deliverable is incomplete and non-functional: (1) test/matrix_gen.bats referenced in workflow step but not provided; (2) test fixtures config.json and test/fixtures/act-case2.json referenced in run_act_tests.sh but missing; (3) .actrc referenced in run_act_tests.sh missing; (4) run_act_tests.sh lacks actionlint validation (task requirement). run_act_tests.sh has poor error handling (git init, cp, mktemp failures won't stop execution, mktemp -d error uncaught). As written, workflow fails at 'Run bats test suite' step. With missing files supplied, code quality is excellent; as delivered, cannot execute.
